la:adj:xanthus.html:
Xanthus, i, m., = Ξάνθος,
the name of several rivers.
A river of Troas, confounded by many with the Scamander, ; ; ; ; ; ; —
A river in Lycia, near a town of the same name, now Essenide, ; ; ; ; ; .—
A small stream in Epirus, .

la:noun:xanthos.html:
xanthos, i, m., = ξάνθος,
a precious stone of a golden color, otherwise unknown, .

la:other:Xanthus.gloss: The name of several rivers and their associated deities, especially the Scamander.
senses: The name of several rivers and their associated deities, especially the Scamander.
